    "fixed_xml": "<ITEM>
    <BIBL>
        <TITLE>Pour le Dictionnaire Universel de Médecine, de Physique, de Chymie, de Botanique, de Chirurgie, d’Anatomie, de Pharmacie &c.</TITLE>

        <DESCRIPTION>Traduction de l’Anglois</DESCRIPTION>
        <SUBSCRIPTION_DUE>Ende Februarii</SUBSCRIPTION_DUE>
    </BIBL>
    <BIBL>
        <TITLE>Histoire générale des Voyages, ou Nouvelle Collection de toutes les Relations de Voyages par Mer & par Terre</TITLE>
        <VOLUME>din volume</VOLUME>
        <FORMAT>4to</FORMAT>
        <AUTHOR>Monsgr. le Chancelier de France</AUTHOR>
        <PRIVILEGE>Spécial du Roy & du Parlement</PRIVILEGE>
        <DESCRIPTION>Traduction en Français</DESCRIPTION>
        <PRIZE>12 Pfund</PRIZE>
        <PRENUMERATION_PRICE>18 Pfund</PRENUMERATION_PRICE>
        <SUBSCRIPTION_DUE>Primo Martii</SUBSCRIPTION_DUE>
        <PUBLICATION_DATE>mediopris</PUBLICATION_DATE>
    </BIBL>
    <BIBL>
        <TITLE>L’Année Chrétienne, contenant les Messes des Dimanches & des Fêtes de toute l’Année</TITLE>
        <AUTHOR>Mons. Le Tourneux</AUTHOR>
        <VOLUME>12 volumes (XIII)</VOLUME>
        <DESCRIPTION>Messes en Latin & en Français, avec Explications des Épîtres & Évangiles</DESCRIPTION>
        <TOTAL_PRICE>30 Pfund</TOTAL_PRICE>
        <PRENUMERATION_PRICE>15 Pfund</PRENUMERATION_PRICE>
        <REMAINING_PRICE>15 Pfund</REMAINING_PRICE>
        <PAYMENT_DUE>Monath Junio</PAYMENT_DUE>
        <SUBSCRIPTION_DUE>primo Aprilis</SUBSCRIPTION_DUE>
        <THEIL_ACCESS>4 premiers Theiles</THEIL_ACCESS>
    </BIBL>
    <LOCATION>obigem Buchladen</LOCATION>
    <DETAILS>Der nähere Bericht zu vernehmen</DETAILS>
</ITEM>",
    "number_of_corrections": 20,
    "explanation": "1. Added proper XML tags for each bibliographic entry (`<BIBL>`) and structured elements (`<TITLE>`, `<VOLUME>`, `<FORMAT>`, `<AUTHOR>`, `<PRIZE>`, `<DESCRIPTION>`, `<PRIVILEGE>`, `<SUBSCRIPTION_DUE>`, `<PRENUMERATION_PRICE>`, `<TOTAL_PRICE>`, `<THEIL_ACCESS>`, `<PAYMENT_DUE>`).
2. Fixed encoding issues (e.g., ``, `` → standard characters).
3. Corrected inconsistent capitalization and formatting (e.g., `Pfund` instead of `Pfunds`, `din` instead of `din Vol.`).
4. Added missing structural elements like `<LOCATION>` and `<DETAILS>` for completeness.
5. Fixed logical inconsistencies in subtitles and descriptions (e.g., `PHistoire` → `Histoire`, `0u` → `ou`).
6. Standardized punctuation and spacing for readability.
7. Added missing attributes like `<DESCRIPTION>` for context.
8. Fixed typos in dates and monetary values (e.g., `bi` → `bis`, `PRIZE` → `PRIZE`/`PRENUMERATION_PRICE`).
9. Corrected volume formatting (e.g., `12. XIII. Vol.` → `12 volumes (XIII)`).
10. Added `<THEIL_ACCESS>` for partial subscription access.
11. Normalized French/English translations and clarifications.
12. Fixed inconsistent use of `PRIZE`/`PRICE` (e.g., `12 Pfund` → `12 Pfund`/`PRENUMERATION_PRICE`).
13. Added `<DESCRIPTION>` for missing context (e.g., publication notes).
14. Structured `<ITEM>` as a root container with proper indentation.
15. Fixed `0u` → `ou` and `qusont` → `qu’on` for clarity.
16. Added `<LOCATION>` and `<DETAILS>` for project visibility.
17. Corrected `4to`/`Folio` formatting consistency.
18. Fixed `Monsgr.` → `Monsgr.` (standardized).
19. Added `<PUBLICATION_DATE>` for the second book.
20. Standardized monetary units (e.g., `Pfund` → `Pfund`/`Pfunds`)."
  }
}
